questions.q: Choose the correct option: “He talks as though he ____ everything.”
questions.why: 'As though' for an unreal present takes the past form. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2026.

questions.q: Change into direct speech: He asked her whether she would attend the meeting.
opts: He said to her, “Will you attend the meeting?”
He said to her, “Did you attend the meeting?”
He said to her, “Are you attending the meeting?”
He said to her, “Whether will you attend the meeting?”
questions.why: 'Would' in reported speech returns to 'will'; question order is restored. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: Never I have seen such chaos.
Never have I seen such chaos.
Never I had seen such chaos.
Never did I saw such chaos.
questions.why: Negative adverb first, then auxiliary before the subject. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2026.

questions.q: Spot the error: “Either the clerk or the officers is responsible for the delay.”
questions.why: With either/or, the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('officers'): 'are'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Spot the error: “The patient, along with his relatives, were waiting outside.”
questions.why: Phrases like 'along with' do not change the subject ('patient'): 'was waiting'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: “a doctor who treats children”
Choose the correct word: “He prided ____ on his punctuality.”
questions.why: 'Pride' is followed by a reflexive pronoun. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the part of speech of “after” in: “She left after the meeting had ended.”
questions.why: It joins the clause 'the meeting had ended' to the main clause. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct option: “He was angry ____ the unfair decision.”
questions.why: Angry at a thing (angry with a person). GPSC CBRT, May 2026.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “He is senior ____ me by two years.”
questions.why: Senior, junior, superior and inferior take 'to'. GPSC-style practice item.
